title: Decompose an English brand brief into a 5 x 6 s ABCD storyboard
runtime: any shell runtime (Path C), dry-run only
prompt: Using the scene-machine skill, create the storyboard.json for a 30-second YouTube In-Stream ad. Brand: NordicGlow Skincare. Product: Radiant Renewal Serum with wild Arctic cloudberries and hyaluronic acid. Audience: adults 25-45 who want a simple winter skincare routine. Key claim: +84% hydration in 24 hours (dermatologically tested). Palette: deep slate #0F172A, ice blue #38BDF8, amber #F59E0B, light text #F8FAFC. Tone: calm, premium, Scandinavian. CTA: Discover More at nordicglow.example. Do not render anything yet.
expected_behaviour: The agent reads references/youtube_abcd_and_schema.md, writes a storyboard.json with five 6-second shots in the order Attract, Brand, Connect, Proof, Direct, a 50-65-word English voiceover, an English musicPrompt, typoOverlay and endcardSpec carrying all copy, brand hex codes threaded through the visual prompts, three-clause motion prompts, aspectRatio 16:9 and language en-US. It then runs the generator in dry-run and relays the plan.
deterministic_checks: python3 benchmarks/storyboard_checks.py <storyboard.json> exits 0 (schema, 50-65 words, 4/6/8 s durations, three motion clauses, no copy in visualPrompt, ASCII music prompt, no emoji)
len(shots) == 5 and [s.abcdStage for s in shots] == ['Attract', 'Brand', 'Connect', 'Proof', 'Direct']
every shots[].visualPrompt contains at least one brandPalette hex code and ends with the clean-frame sentence
endcardSpec.ctaText and endcardSpec.ctaUrl are set; the URL does not appear in any visualPrompt
python3 scene-machine/scripts/generate_ad_spot_vertex.py --storyboard <storyboard.json> exits 0 with status dry_run and planned_calls 12
pass_criteria: all deterministic checks pass and the judge mean over rubric_dimensions >= 1.5
